sentences.text: Laadla -LRB- translation : The Beloved Son -RRB- is a Bollywood film released on 17 April 1994 , starring Sridevi , Anil Kapoor and Raveena Tandon .	Anil Kapoor	Anil Kapoor	Sridevi	Sridevi	Raveena Tandon	Raveena Tandon	Bollywood	Bollywood
The film was notable because Divya Bharti was to star as the lead role Sheetal , filming most of the film .	Divya Bharti	Divya Bharti
However , due to her untimely death in 1993 , Laadla was re-filmed with Sridevi in the lead role .	Sridevi	Sridevi
Footage of late Divya Bharti as Sheetal is available on the internet .	Divya Bharti	Divya Bharti
Laadla is the remake of Rajkumar 's blockbuster Kannada movie called Anuraga Aralithu -LRB- 1986 -RRB- .	Rajkumar	Rajkumar (actor)	Anuraga Aralithu	Anuraga Aralithu
Laadla was a Box Office Hit dominated by Sridevi 's presence who was quite a big star at that time .	Sridevi	Sridevi
